result.title: SceneForesee: Learning Scene Evolution for Spatiotemporal Reasoning
result.summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) need to understand how entities move and interact as a scene develops. This requires following the same entities over time and relating their observed motion to subsequent changes. We formulate Scene Evolution Understanding (SEU), a task for predicting and interpreting this change. Given observed video, a model estimates entity histories and predicts one scene continuation through future trajectories and Events, accompanied by Visual Evidence from observed motion and a scene description. We construct SceneForesee, a benchmark for evaluating entity continuity and scene evolution reasoning through paired observed and future scenes with shared entity identities. It contains 144.57K temporal pairs, 1.05M entity correspondences, and 272.49K Events paired with observed evidence. We propose a spatiotemporal reasoning framework, EvoSee, that learns future geometry and Event semantics through shared candidate states and joint assignment. It selects one continuation per entity from observation and uses the selected changes for entity refinement, retention, and scene representation. On SceneForesee, EvoSee outperforms Qwen3.5-9B by 10.45 points in Combined Point-F1 and 17.24 points in Event Global F1. On the 4D reasoning benchmark Dyn-Bench, it improves question answering accuracy and grounding J&F by 4.8 and 3.58 points over their respective base systems. These results support scene evolution as both a prediction target and a dynamic representation that brings predicted entity changes into spatiotemporal reasoning.The project is available at https://github.com/mikubaka88/SceneForesee-Spatiotemporal-Reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「场景演化理解」任务与 SceneForesee 基准（含时间配对、实体对应与事件标注），并给出 EvoSee 框架，通过共享候选状态与联合分配来预测未来轨迹和事件、更新实体与场景表示，在多模态模型上取得了提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨时间跟踪同一实体、以观测运动作为 Visual Evidence 并选择候选状态更新场景表示，与 LVR 关注的实体关系保留、内部状态更新和视觉证据筛选直接相关，可供核查预测表示能否承载实体连续性与后续推理。
